hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers afterInitialize permission to validate hook address constraints at deployment. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; actual pool setup is performed via initializePools(), which delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract.
